title: Small fixes
subtitle: A selection of 2 fixes from a sweep of API parameter gaps.
footer: Each fix closes a gap between what an upstream API accepts and what the client forwarded for it. The excerpts are trimmed from the pull requests; tests and fixtures are omitted.

fixes.title: max_completion_tokens as an alias
fixes.description: Backends advertised max_tokens, but a request that named the same cap as max_completion_tokens failed the parameter filter and was routed away. Both names are canonicalized before the set lookup, so a backend advertising either one matches either one.

fixes.title: tool_choice none and required
fixes.description: The adapter rejected any tool_choice other than auto with a 400, although the upstream API also takes none and required. The three documented strings pass through. Named-function objects and unknown strings are still rejected.
